cited.quote: administrative sanction for construction of hostel for College Girls

rationale: C5 shows GO 44 (28.05.2019) following an earlier GO dated 06.03.2019 that gave administrative sanction for a new hostel for college girls and ITI students in Royapuram; this is a new hostel started. C1 and C2 describe upgrades and existing hostels only. Scope of a single new hostel against a general promise leaves some doubt.

cited.quote: Rs.8,50,00,000/- (Rupees eight crore and fifty lakh only) from State Innovation Fund towards Tamil Nadu Free Public WiFi Services Development
on 05.04.2018 at the following 5 locations: Chennai-Uzhaipalar silai, Marina Beach

rationale: C3 is the GO of 16.08.2017 sanctioning funds for free public WiFi in public places such as bus stands and parks. C1 reports the scheme launched on 05.04.2018 at bus stands and Marina Beach, with 50 places planned in the first phase. Coverage of shopping complexes is not shown, so scope is only partly confirmed.

cited.quote: 1,597 units of shade nets were installed and 9 crore seedlings were distributed to cover an area of 15,177 acres

rationale: C2 reports the Sustainable Sugarcane Initiative scheme was promoted during 2017-18 (shade nets installed, seedlings distributed) and is programmed for 2018-19. C1 and C3 show related continuing support. The scheme predates this government, so the date only marks evidence of continued implementation within 2017-18.

cited.quote: Construction of 20,000 Check Dams at a total cost of Rs.250.36 Crore under MGNREGS for the year 2017-18
rehabilitation and improvement works are in progress in 47 dams in Coimbatore, Cuddalore, Dharmapuri
Rehabilitation of 39 irrigation related infrastructures such as rehabilitation works in 1 Dam, 2 Anicuts, 25 Tanks

rationale: C4 is the GO of 05.01.2018 permitting construction of 20,000 check dams. C2 and C3 show dam and canal rehabilitation works in progress. Barrage construction appears only as a detailed project report under consideration (C1), so that component is not shown as implemented. Dates for dam rehabilitation start are not given.

cited.quote: The construction of 10,000 Green Houses have been completed in co-ordination with the Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department.
The construction of all the 10,000 Green Houses have been completed in co-ordination with the Rural Development

rationale: C1 and C2 report the green houses scheme for handloom weavers carried out, with all 10,000 houses completed. No GO or launch date appears in the extracts, and the policy notes' own dates are not official steps, so no realisation date can be given.

cited.quote: G.O(MS)No 74: Industries-Implementation of New Industrial Policy 2021-Orders-Issued

rationale: C3 is a dedicated GO (11.02.2021) implementing the new Industrial Policy 2021, whose subject is attracting industrial investment, with incentives and ease-of-doing-business measures. This satisfies the order indicator for a directional commitment. Earlier investment-promotion activity exists in other extracts but is not an order.

cited.quote: the State Government organised the second edition of Global Investors Meet (GIM) on 23rd and 24th January 2019 in Chennai
Constitution of a special Investment Promotion Task Force under the Chairmanship of Chief Secretary to attract investors

rationale: C2 reports the state-organised Global Investors Meet 2019 with road shows, an investment promotion campaign (23-24 January 2019). C3 is the GO of 29.04.2020 constituting an Investment Promotion Task Force. Both meet the indicator; the earlier dated one is the 2019 campaign.

cited.quote: The land allotment order has been issued to the prospective developer for establishing fish processing park in Kanniyakumari
Government has issued orders to call for retender for allocation of land in Cuddalore, Nagapattinam and Ramanathapuram districts

rationale: C1 and C2 report land allotment orders issued for a fish processing park in Kanniyakumari with works in progress, and orders for retender in three other districts: dedicated official measures on this subject. The orders carry no date in the extracts, so no realisation date can be given.

cited.quote: suitable sites have been identified for the establishment of fish processing parks
The land allotment orders has been issued to the selected developer for establishing fish processing park in Kanniyakumari district

rationale: C1 and C2 show sites identified in four districts and land allotment orders issued for fish processing parks in Kanniyakumari, Thiruvallur and Thoothukudi. The indicator is met, but the orders are undated in the extracts and policy-note dates are not official steps, so no date is given.

cited.quote: 25% subsidy for establishment of Industrial Clusters and Mini Tool Rooms under Public Private Partnership
In addition to Capital Subsidy, Industrial Park developers will be eligible for Industrial Housing Incentive of 10%

rationale: C3 shows an existing 25% subsidy (maximum Rs.1 crore) for clusters under PPP, a different and smaller scheme than the promised 50% up to Rs.10 crore. C4 shows capital subsidy for industrial park developers without the promised rate or ceiling. No extract shows the promised subsidy ordered.

cited.quote: Krishnagiri Palacode Mango 8 Dharmapuri Dharmapuri Tomato 9 Theni Cumbum, Odaipatti Grapes, Banana
Market Complex for Tender Coconut was established at a cost of Rs.3.25 crore

rationale: C1 lists specialised market complexes for mango, grapes, banana, tender coconut and vegetables at a total cost of Rs.64.07 crore; C3 reports the tender coconut and vegetable market complexes established. No GO or opening date is given, and whether each complex is operational is not clear, so no date is given.

cited.quote: During the year 2016-2017, loan amount of Rs.541.94 lakh has been disbursed to 777 beneficiaries under these schemes
During the year 2019-2020 up to 29.02.2020, loan amount of Rs. 954.14 lakh has been disbursed to 1,437 beneficiaries

rationale: C2 and C1 show TAMCO continuing to give low-interest loans (5-8% interest) with disbursements in 2016-17 and 2019-20. The corporation predates this government, so the year marks the first reported continued disbursement in 2016-17 (year given as 2017 to stay after taking office).

cited.quote: Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department will be implementing the Programme in all the Rural Districts

rationale: The extracts show a livelihood mission (TNSRLM, C1-C3) running across village panchayats and a self-sufficiency programme for panchayats (C4, C5), but none shows integrating two or three village panchayats into units with location-specific livelihood schemes. Only related activity is shown.

cited.quote: accord administrative sanction for provision of free internet facility in 366 Government Higher Secondary Schools

rationale: C1 is the GO of 12.10.2017 sanctioning free internet in 366 Government Higher Secondary Schools in Educationally Backward Blocks, with 50 schools first. This covers part of the higher secondary component; no extract shows free internet for college students.

cited.quote: ordered and provided 750 units free electricity to powerloom weavers bimonthly including fixed charges with effect from 23.05.2016
enhanced the supply of free electricity to powerloom weavers from 500 units to 750 units including fixed charges

rationale: C2 states the Government ordered and provided 750 units of free electricity to powerloom weavers bimonthly from 23.05.2016, in line with the manifesto promise; C1 confirms the increase from 500 to 750 units and the beneficiaries. Scope and amount match the promise.

cited.quote: Special Package for pulses cultivation in the potential districts - Demonstration in an area of 60,000 acres
A special self-sufficiency Pulse Production Programme will be launched this year, specifically for promoting cultivation of green gram

rationale: C2 is a 2016 budget announcement of a special self-sufficiency pulse programme (intent only). C4 is the GO of 07.02.2017 sanctioning a special package for pulses cultivation with Rs.50 crore dovetailed funds over 60,000 acres, the first dated official step. It is a package rather than a named mission, so some doubt remains.

cited.quote: the area which was 6.37 Lakh Ha in 2010-11 has increased to 8.84 Lakh ha in 2014-15

rationale: C1, the Agriculture Policy Note 2018-19 (12.07.2018), is an administrative report giving pulse area, production and productivity figures. C3 and C5 (GO of 07.02.2017) cite production figures but are orders, not reports. Earlier notes may also report these figures but none shown here does.

cited.quote: Amma Two Wheeler Scheme is a State funded special scheme implemented from 2017-18

rationale: C1 shows a subsidy for two-wheelers for working women, and C3 shows auto-rickshaw loans for minorities; both are neighbouring schemes. No extract shows driving training for women or a subsidy to women for buying auto-rickshaws.

cited.quote: Measures for the Maintenance of Standards in Higher Education, 2018
a High Level Committee under the Chairmanship of the Principal Secretary, Higher Education Department is hereby constituted

rationale: C4 is the GO (Ms) No. 5 of 11.01.2021 adopting UGC regulations on qualifications and measures for maintaining standards in higher education for colleges: a policy guideline on college quality. C1 (03.09.2020) only constitutes a committee to study the National Education Policy, a preparatory step.

cited.quote: An induction programme of one month shall be introduced for all newlyrecruited Assistant Professors

rationale: C3 is GO (Ms) No. 5 (11.01.2021) adopting UGC regulations on standards in higher education, introducing an induction programme for new Assistant Professors and career advancement rules in colleges: academic reforms aimed at standards. C5 shows only smaller support schemes without dates.
